name: Requirements Discovery & Brainstorming
description: Clarify intent, constraints, users, and success criteria before proposing a design.
instructions: Before implementation: inspect the existing project context. Clarify the user's actual goal, constraints, users, and definition of success. Ask one focused question at a time when essential information is missing. Present a small set of materially different approaches with trade-offs. Do not start implementation until the user approves the chosen direction.
